intro: Lesson 95: Grammar: past tense, time connectives and paragraphs in a diary. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Not this
This
rows: We arrived in Oklahoma and the sky goes black.
We arrived in Oklahoma and the sky went black.

parts.text: Paragraph 1: Early that morning, we left the motel.
Paragraph 2: By lunchtime, a storm had rolled in.
Paragraph 3: That evening, the sky cleared.
Each new time = a new paragraph

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: Three paragraphs, each starting with a time connective

keywords.def: verbs for things that already happened
a verb that does not add -ed in the past: drive, drove
a word or phrase that shows when
staying the same all the way through

questions.q: Fix: Then we see a huge storm.
questions.a: Then we saw a huge storm.

questions.q: Add a time connective: ___, we reached the motel.
Core: complete 10 sentences with the correct past tense and three time connectives
Extend: organise a jumbled diary into three paragraphs with time connectives
Stretch: use the past perfect: By the time we arrived, the storm had passed.

questions.a: B) We stopped and ate pancakes.. Both verbs are in the past tense: stopped and ate.
